fact: On 18 November 2022 the Secretary General of the Ministry of Plan described the third national statistics development strategy SNDS 2022-2026 as the reference framework for statistical activity, guiding the 5th census and the agriculture census.
title: 32ème édition de la Journée Africaine de la Statistique : La direction régionale de l'INS de Niamey ouvre ses portes au public
